item.title: The Go For It, Nakamura! Controversy & Syundei’s X/Twitter Exit
item.description: Manga artist Syundei, the creator of Go For It, Nakamura-kun!, deleted her X (formerly Twitter) account on April 12 following a severe wave of online harassment.
